rationale: Downstream overshoot establishes a temporary peak, which can coexist with reduced downstream delay and end-to-end turnaround after settling. It therefore does not distinguish relocation of delay from removal of delay, even at the tested operating point and as a tentative explanation.
signal_basis: - Overshoot and peak: whether a queue or turnaround temporarily exceeds its eventual level (for example a surge arriving downstream after an upstream release), and the height and timing of that peak.
